files.findings/README.txt:
Static-analysis findings, reporting package.

findings.txt holds one line per recorded finding.
policy.txt defines the three bands findings are sorted into.
files.findings/policy.txt:
Triage policy

Findings are banded by the score the analyser gave them.
Band A: a score lower than triage.band_low.
Band B: from triage.band_low up to, but not including, triage.band_high.
Band C: triage.band_high or more.
The two values are kept in the project configuration.
